title: campanula cervicaria var. dalmatica
intro: Campanula cervicaria var. dalmatica, commonly known as Dalmatian bellflower, is a plant species in the Campanulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dalmatian bellflower include analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it useful for relieving pain, reducing muscle spasms, and expelling mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
